value: The last two tablets lie among the Smolderthorn trolls in Blackrock Spire. With this pair, the quest's six-tablet search reaches its stated count. The tablets deepen the written record, but the seeker still depends on Ironboot to interpret what they mean for the egg and for the power Yeh'kinya tried to contain.
